title: NexusCraft
blurb: Survival, skyblock, prison, one block and ten minigames, on one server. Custom textures, custom armour, and a world boss that turns up whether you are ready or not.
modesLede: Everything runs on the one server and one login. Walk into a portal at spawn and you are there.

modes.name: Survival
modes.blurb: The ordinary game, with land claims so what you build stays built. Homes, shops, jobs and a nether and end of its own.

modes.name: Skyblock
modes.blurb: A tree, a chest, and a long way down. Island levels, a generator that pays out better the further you get, and team islands.

modes.name: One Block
modes.blurb: Break the same block forever. What it gives back changes as you go, and the drops get stranger the deeper the phase.

modes.name: Prison
modes.blurb: Mine, sell, rank up, repeat. Straightforward on purpose, and the fastest way to make money if that is what you are here for.

modes.name: The Dig Site
modes.blurb: A pit that refills every half hour. Everyone digs the same hole for whatever is buried in it, and the countdown moves you out before it closes.

modes.name: Minigames
modes.blurb: Bed Wars, Sky Wars, Spleef, TNT Run, Murder Mystery, Hide and Seek, Dropper, Parkour, Sumo and One in the Chamber.

modes.name: The World Boss
modes.blurb: A Warden rises in the survival world on a timer. Everyone who lands a hit takes a share of the purse, not just whoever finishes it.

modes.name: Custom gear
modes.blurb: Armour sets that are real armour wearing our own textures, handed out as gifts and prizes rather than sold.

voteReward: Every vote pays 2,500 coins, and voting on consecutive days multiplies it up to seven times. Every fifth vote is also a rare crate key.
